target.statement: GPT-4o + AnyCap-8B achieves an average content score of 4.54 on instruction-based image captioning (AnyCapEval), compared to GPT-4o's 2.89.

compute.basis: Training AnyCap-8B requires 21 hours on 32 A100 GPUs; even inference with GPT-4o API and evaluation would need substantial compute and data access.

blockers: Requires training AnyCap-8B (21 hours on 32 A100 GPUs)
Needs GPT-4o API access for base captions and evaluation
AnyCapEval benchmark data may not be publicly released
AnyCapData construction uses proprietary models (GPT-4o, InternVL2.5-78B, Qwen2.5-VL-72B)
title: AnyCap Project: A Unified Framework, Dataset, and Benchmark for Controllable Omni-modal Captioning
